method: Read full source and every domain/evidence field from immutable pre-review byte snapshots; frozen validator + five-field/evidence/serialization checks. No historical05 consulted.

records.coverage: 破曲同宫与三合适用范围区分，五行说明不造四化；有吉尤其左右例外保留。 V4进一步按先贤条件补负同宫，保留V2误接受及V3撤回。V2补齐武曲及组合星mentioned、讨论状态，未推具体实际宫位。
records.binding: full relation/scopes/evidence read; issues separately recorded
records.time: no fixed age or publication year turned into transit; case cycle preserved
records.content_type: all concept explanations; introductions are not case analyses
records.english: complete source and summaries compared; C092 unsupported polarity removed and verified
records.source_quality: eligible: complete readable conceptual text, no lowering due to representation gaps
